title: Origanum majorana essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Origanum majorana essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowering plant commonly known as marjoram. It is obtained through steam distillation of the fresh or dried aerial parts of the plant, which contains a variety of bioactive compounds. In herbalism, this essential oil is valued for its warming, antispasmodic, and digestive properties. It is often used to support respiratory health, ease menstrual discomfort, and promote relaxation. Additionally, it is applied topically for muscle pain relief and can be diffused to enhance mood and reduce stress.
